description: Three-tier underwrite assumptions the analyst fills ONCE per deal, merged deterministically into DealRR before Mode B. Generalises (and replaces) the old flag-per-unit sign-off. Precedence is most-specific-wins: unit override > asset override > deal default. Yields/NEF/growth are decimals (0.0625 = 6.25%). Nothing here is extracted from the schedule - these are the analyst's re-letting and pricing views. A field left null keeps whatever the broker schedule carried (blank stays blank and is reported by normalise_auto.summarise_missing).
notes: Applied by underwrite/engine/apply_assumptions.py:apply_assumptions() into a copy of the DealRR sheet, ahead of inject_deal_v21. FILL_BLANK fields only populate cells the broker left empty (never overwrite broker data). OVERRIDE fields (entry/exit yield = pricing calls) are written to every unit in scope. Deal-level erv_growth ALSO wires to Global Assumptions!D49 (the universal rental-growth cell) so it cascades centrally, matching the Newbury model. Stored on the deal record as `underwrite_assumptions`.

field_columns._comment: canonical assumption field -> DealRR column letter (field-dictionary OLD-letter scheme). Contract with inject_deal_v21.FIELD_MAP.

write_mode._comment: OVERRIDE = write to every unit in scope, replacing schedule values (a deliberate analyst call). FILL_BLANK = only populate cells the broker left empty.

deal.description: Deal / portfolio defaults - the base tier, applied to every unit unless a more specific tier overrides. All optional; a null keeps the schedule value.

assets.description: Per-asset overrides keyed by EXACT asset name (must match DealRR col B / the Cash Flow Output asset register). Typically entry/exit yield per asset plus the rates/service-charge/rateable-value the analyst knows for that property.

units.description: Per-unit overrides - only the genuinely unit-specific calls, entered as a pick-list rather than a flag on every row. Key is '<asset name>::<unit number>' (preferred) or a bare '<unit number>' when unique across the deal.

break_taken.notes: True => this unit exercises its break: DealRR M=1 and Event @ Expiry (O) forced to X (vacate + re-let).

vacate_at_expiry.notes: True => this unit vacates at lease end (Event @ Expiry O = X) rather than renewing.

ga_wiring._comment: Deal-level fields that ALSO write to a Global Assumptions cell so they cascade centrally.
